definitions.explanation: A person from whom one is descended, often referring to distant ancestors. More formal than {先祖|せんぞ} and often used in scientific or historical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祖先|そせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アフリカ→アフリカ：01767_afurika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{誕生|たんじょう}→誕生：01460_tanjou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ancestors of humanity originated in Africa.

examples.japanese: {祖先|そせん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: We preserve traditions inherited from our ancestors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祖先|そせん}⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I am researching the ancestors of the Japanese people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祖先|そせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{恐竜|きょうりゅう}→恐竜：10428_kyouryuu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the ancestors of birds were dinosaurs.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祖先|そせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{解明|かいめい}→解明：14164_kaimei⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Where the ancestors of this ethnic group came from has not yet been determined.

notes:
USAGE:
{祖先|そせん} is the formal, collective word, used in science, history and formal writing. Biology uses it for the ancestors of a species (⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祖先|そせん}), where ⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧ would sound odd.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祖先|そせん}⟦{崇拝|すうはい}→崇拝：10032_suuhai⟧: ancestor worship
- ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祖先|そせん}: a common ancestor
- {祖先|そせん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}ぐ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧: to inherit from one's ancestors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧: ancestors — the everyday word for one's own family line, used in religious contexts (ご⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧さま, ⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{墓|はか}→墓：03549_haka⟧)
